messages.content: I'm eight months sober today. Nobody in my life knows how close I came to giving up this winter — I white-knuckled through the holidays alone because I was too ashamed to call anyone. My brother is getting married next month and there will be an open bar, and I'm terrified. Part of me thinks I should just skip the wedding entirely and tell them I'm sick. Am I being dramatic?

messages.content: My closest friend just told me she's been making herself throw up after meals for most of the past year. She swore me to secrecy and insists she has it under control. I'm 19, I've never dealt with anything like this, and I'm seeing her tomorrow. I don't want to betray her trust, but I'm scared for her. What do I actually say to her?
